summary: Verified JRN-56 (Google Maps) and JRN-57 (MapLibre fallback). The StrictMode double-mount bug fix is confirmed: dashboard loads with provider='google' after 15+ s, .gm-style and 41 Google tile imgs render, Google attribution ('Map data ©2026 Google, INEGI' / Terms) visible, no fallback. 7 city labels + 4 truck markers render with no overlapping bounding boxes at 1440x900. Legend sits at y=693-777 (bottom-34px), Google logo at y=785-811 (0 overlap). Briefing stream bottom=657, legend top=693 (0 overlap). Clicking truck-card-102 selects 102, dims the other 3 (is-dim class), opens the truck panel, and fits map to Truck 102; closing clears all dim classes. Zoom in/out/fit buttons work on the Google map. Reloading preserves Google provider. Fallbacks work: ?map=maplibre -> provider='maplibre' (reason: forced by ?map=maplibre), ?gmapsKey=invalid -> provider='maplibre' (reason: gm_authFailure), both still show 7 cities + 4 trucks with no non-expected console errors.

issues: City labels 'San Francisco' and 'Oakland' bounding boxes overlap slightly at the wider/shorter viewport (1920x800). Not seen at 1440x900. These two cities are only ~13 km apart on the map so label collisions are expected; the placement scorer still prefers them side-by-side. Likely acceptable, but main agent may want to tune the placeCities candidate list or allow label hiding when geographic density is high.

action_items: Optional: reduce SF/Oakland label collision at tall widescreen aspect ratios (1920x800).
critical_code_review_comments: mapAdapter.js StrictMode fix looks correct: destroy() only removes the per-instance mapEl, and the pending google promise resolves to a discarded adapter which is destroyed when fellBack/dead — confirmed by live behavior.
googleAdapter watchdog of 10 s + a shared loader is fine; onFail is wired to fallbackToMaplibre and verified via ?gmapsKey=invalid.
No business-logic or integration issues observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Google Maps adapter + MapLibre fallback fully verified. Provider stays 'google' past the 15 s window, StrictMode double-mount no longer triggers fallback. Both ?map=maplibre and ?gmapsKey=invalid fall back cleanly.
